texto: With **avoir**, the participle matches the direct complement only if it appears before: **J'ai reçu les lettres** but **les lettres que j'ai reçues**. Identify first what the person received.
In the times composed with **être**, the participle normally matches the subject: **Elles sont arrivées**. Compare position and function before deciding termination.

frases.fr: J'ai reçu les lettres ce matin.
frases.es: He recibido las cartas esta mañana.
frases.en: I got the letters this morning.
analisis: I have received (I passed composé with avoir without agreement by COD postponed)

frases.fr: Les lettres que tu as reçues sont-elles signées ?
frases.es: ¿Están firmadas las cartas que has recibido?
frases.en: Are the letters you've received signed?
analisis: you have received (previous relative COD with plural feminine agreement)
Are they signed? (Interrogative investment of être + agreed adjetival participle)

frases.fr: Oui, je les ai envoyées au dossier avec les pièces jointes.
frases.es: Sí, las he enviado al expediente con los documentos adjuntos.
frases.en: Yeah, I sent them to the file with the attached documents.
analisis: I have sent them (previous plural pronoun COD feminine with agreement)
with the attached documents (substantive and adjective avec + preposition feminine plural)

frases.fr: La demande que nous avons préparée est complète.
frases.es: La solicitud que hemos preparado está completa.
frases.en: The request we have prepared is complete.
analisis: we have prepared (previous relative COD with feminine-compliant)

bloques.pregunta: Why is «reçues» written in «les lettres que tu as reçues»?

opciones.texto: Because «les lettres» appears before the verb and is a direct complement.
opciones.explicacion: With «avoir», there is agreement if the COD precedes the verb.

opciones.texto: Porque todos los participios con «avoir» concuerdan.
opciones.explicacion: The rule depends on the COD position.

bloques.pregunta: What documents were sent to the file?

opciones.texto: The letters and the attached documents.

opciones.explicacion: The application is described as complete.
The text says the letters are signed.

bloques.frase: Les lettres que j'ai ___ sont signées.

opciones.explicacion: No agreement in this context, no.

bloques.frase: La demande que nous avons préparée est complète.

opciones.texto: The request we have prepared is complete.
We have prepared the full application.
opciones.explicacion: It changes the structure and order of the information.

bloques.pregunta: What shape matches «les demandes» in «Les demandes que j'ai ___»?

opciones.explicacion: The plural COD feminine appears before the participle.
It does not agree in this context.

bloques.frase: La lettre qu'elle a ___ est signée.
J'ai reçu les lettres, puis les lettres que j'ai reçues ont été classées.

opciones.texto: I got the letters and then the letters that I had received were archived.
opciones.explicacion: No match to COD behind; match to COD in front.

opciones.texto: I got the letters that I was filed.

intro: In the composite times, the position of the direct complement determines whether the past participle agrees.
